env.//verify: CLAUDE_VERIFY_*_CMD are repo-scoped (same toolchain for every developer + CI), so they live in checked-in settings.json — not gitignored settings.local.json. stop-verify.sh runs them on Stop; a developer may override per-machine in settings.local.json (Claude Code merges local over shared).
env.CLAUDE_VERIFY_LINT_CMD: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .

network.//: Tailored for Python/uv stack. Add ML/data hosts (e.g. huggingface.co, *.pytorch.org, database.lichess.org) here if sandboxed runs need them.

statusLine.//: statusLine · custom command status line. Shows when context is filling so you know when to /clear. Schema per https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline: `type:command` + a shell command that reads JSON session data on stdin and prints the line. Color tiers (green/yellow/orange/red at 10/20/30%) align with CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=400000 above (red = act before auto-compact, not after); see the script's header comment for the full mapping.

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ty check && uv run pytest --tb=short -q

file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ "${file##*.}" = "py" ]; then cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && uv run ruff format "$file" 2>/dev/null || true && uv run ruff check --fix "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
